visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene starts at a shop counter with a female clerk wearing a beige blouse and a black apron with an 'aotter' logo. A customer's hand holds a smartphone displaying the Easy Wallet app. The setting is bright and clean with a tablet on a stand, a calculator, and notes visible on the counter. (2) The camera cuts to a young woman with short black hair wearing a purple fleece sweater and a pink neck bow, looking frustrated as she holds her phone. Her friend is seen beside her, suggesting a faster payment method. The lighting is uniform and soft indoor lighting. (3) The video transitions to a digital screen capture of an iPhone interface. It shows the user navigating the 'Shortcuts' app, searching for 'Integrated Mobile Payment 2.0', and adding it to their library. The screen displays various payment icons like Apple Pay and Line Pay clearly. (4) The screen capture continues, showing the iPhone lock screen with a personalized wallpaper of a woman posing. The user long-presses the screen to enter customization mode, adds a new widget, and selects the previously added shortcut to create a quick-access button on the lock screen. (5) Back at the counter, the main character in the purple sweater smiles broadly and points to her phone screen. She successfully accesses the payment menu with one tap. Her expression is joyful, and her hand gestures indicate excitement and approval of the tech tip. (6) Another clerk enters the frame from the side, looking slightly confused or impatient. The main character looks surprised and quickly apologizes, moving her phone as if preparing to finalize the transaction. The scene ends in a medium full shot showing the interaction at the checkout.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a practical tutorial designed to teach iPhone users how to use the 'Shortcuts' app to create a quick-access payment menu on their lock screen. It uses a relatable real-life scenario of fumbling for a payment app at a counter to demonstrate the utility of the feature.
